calls.title: Kris Washburn Role Play exercise
calls.summary: Chris Washburn detailed the pre-call preparation process, emphasizing the importance of tailored approaches based on product and market context. Chris utilizes AI cautiously for initial discovery calls, dedicating more time for complex deals. The discovery strategy at Antithesis involves educating prospects and understanding their infrastructure needs. Chris highlighted interview insights from a call with Roblox, where the company aims to significantly increase experimentation volume and is evaluating vendors like Growth Book. The negotiation phase revealed pricing tensions as Roblox compared offers, ultimately leading to a three-year deal with escalating payments that aligned with their budget. Feedback from peers on Chris's performance noted areas for improvement in quantifying value during discussions and highlighted strengths in building credibility.
calls.keywords: Executive sales preparation, discovery call, competitive pricing negotiation, trial evaluation, product segmentation, hiring pipeline
